spec2def(updspapi.dll updspapi.spec)

# updspapi.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/updspapi-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(updspapi_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(updspapi_shims PRIVATE wine libsetupapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(updspapi_shims)
add_cargo_module(updspapi updspapi-cargo updspapi.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS updspapi_shims psdk)
